content.title: Oracle Names Co-CEOs to Replace Safra Catz. The Stock Rises.
content.summary: Oracle  has promoted both Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia to the roles of CEO in a move that will see current Chief Executive Safra Catz become executive vice chair of the Oracle board.  The move signals Oracle’s continued focus on artificial intelligence and cloud computing.  Magouyrk, 39, previously served as president of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, the company’s fast-growing AI cloud provider.

content.title: How Gartner’s Expanded $7 Billion Buyback Plan May Shape Value for IT Investors
content.summary: On September 10, 2025, Gartner announced an increase in its share buyback plan, raising its total authorization by US$1.0 billion to US$7.0 billion.
